Fiscal Year 2027 Key Initiatives
OpenGov Financials & OpenGov Planning & Budgeting
 Ensure a smooth transition to OpenGov Financials and Planning &
 Budgeting platforms
 Improve financial reporting, transparency, and accessibility of
 information
     Provide City Council and the public with easier access to real   -time
     financial information
     Increase transparency and visibility into City finances
 Goal to prepare the FY 2028 budget within OpenGov Budgeting
 Manage implementation activities, including:
    Carefully plan implementation to minimize disruption
    Data migration
    Temporarily working in dual systems
    Staff training
